turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the pile at least 30 feet from the wall, or cover it fully with sheet metal instead of the tarp.
findings.reason: The first frame shows an uncovered stack of logs sitting against the wall, which you said you cover with a tarp at night.

findings.instruction: Replace the 5 feet of old cedar fence by the house with metal or brick posts and rails.
findings.reason: The third frame shows the old cedar fence meeting the house wall.

findings.instruction: Haul that weekend cutting to the green waste bin, even if it still looks green.
findings.reason: The second frame shows a pile of cut branches on the ground, which you said is last weekend's cutting.
